notes: contains multiple mesh components/loose parts likely representing individual stone blocks

blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval stone pillar or pier consisting of a tiered square stone base with beveled edging, a central vertical square shaft made of stacked stone blocks/bricks, an overhanging square capital with beveled trim underneath, and a smaller square plinth holding a spherical stone ball finial on top. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with hand-painted stylized stone textures featuring soft edge wear and highlights. The main pillar shaft is colored cool slate-grey while the base trim, capital, and sphere have slightly warmer brownish-grey tones.
blind.from_above: A concentric square composition: the outer square outline of the capital/base framing a smaller raised square platform with a central smooth sphere, marked with faint stone seam lines dividing the capstone into quadrants.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 feet tall (reaches around shoulder height, roughly 80-85% of the figure's height) and about 2 feet wide at its square base.
